name: Human Feedback & Approval
purpose: Present one SHA-256-pinned Runnable Candidate to a human, record either exact approval or bounded feedback, and let Core choose only the fixed ST-07 Graph route justified by that decision.
completion_criteria: Core snapshots the Runnable Candidate and pins the Review Manifest to the exact Requirements, Architecture Current, Build Contract, Effective Policy, System Map, source revisions, and machine Evidence used for review.
A human explicitly approves the exact Review Manifest and passes every human-at-st07 check, or explicitly records one or more feedback impacts tied to known requirement IDs.
For feedback, Core deterministically chooses the earliest required fixed Graph target: ST-03, ST-04, ST-05, or ST-06; AI cannot choose or write the route.
For approval, Core creates an Accepted Candidate and promotes only the accepted source revisions to a new immutable System Map revision before advancing through the fixed ST-07 to ST-08 edge.
A not_applicable Build Current creates no Review Manifest or Accepted Candidate and reuses the exact ST-05 human approval as deterministic Evidence.
stop_conditions: The Build Current, Runnable Candidate, Requirements, Architecture Current, Build Contract, Effective Policy, System Map baseline, Review Manifest, Human Decision, or referenced Evidence is missing, malformed, stale, tampered, or inconsistent.
The Candidate revision is unavailable, changed files differ from the pinned Candidate, or the shared System Map baseline changed after the Build Contract was approved.
Human check results are missing, duplicated, unknown, or failed while approval is requested.
Feedback references an unknown requirement, has no confirmed impact, or cannot be mapped to exactly one fixed Graph target by the deterministic earliest-stage rule.
Review would execute a remote, destructive, credential-bearing, release, deployment, or Production operation.
